notes: Lists: the List widget is now “General List” and the Google one “To-Do List (Google)”. The Lists page is headed “Lists and To-Dos”, with To-Do (Google) first, a short explanation and new icons
General lists: the “X to get” count is gone, and ticking several things quickly on the Corsair no longer loses any of them (the same fix for To-Do (Google))
Rewards: Tasks are now “Reward Tasks” and the checklists “Daily To-Dos”
Reminders has its own page (⚙ Widgets → Reminders). Rewards keeps a simple “Reminder Display” page: show reminders on the Reward Widgets or not
Widget names without brackets: Trains, Bus stop and Bins show a small “UK only” label; the Reminders widget is now “Children’s reminders”
Family Admin: notes are sticky notes, two to a row, like on the dashboard
